headline: Constructor, a company that runs product search for online retailers, has launched a checkout feature that lets shoppers pay inside its AI shopping assistant.
score_reason: Pool score kept: real product launch, but the “first” claim is the company’s own and adoption is not shown.
importance_line: Shoppers on sites that use Constructor, such as Sephora, could buy through a chat-style assistant, though the “first” claim is the company’s and no usage figures were given.
summary: Retail Technology Innovation Hub reports that Constructor, which supplies search and product discovery for retailers including Sephora, has launched Agentic Checkout, letting shoppers pay through Stripe, including its Link wallet, without leaving the retailer’s AI shopping agent. Constructor claims it is the first to offer Stripe-powered checkout inside an onsite shopping agent and says it will extend the feature to more parts of retailers’ sites later this year.
notes: Company announcement relayed by a trade outlet.
